title: Data Lineage `runs.list` Method Gains New Scopes
summary: The `projects.locations.processes.runs.list` method in the Data Lineage API now supports dedicated `datalineage.read-write` and `datalineage.readonly` OAuth scopes. This provides more granular permission control for listing lineage runs.
details: Developers can now use the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datalineage.read-write` and `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datalineage.readonly` OAuth scopes when calling the `projects.locations.processes.runs.list` method. This enhancement allows for more precise access management, ensuring that applications only request the necessary permissions to list lineage run data.
